Make your first song

1. Make a beat. Click New to start fresh. In the Step Sequencer, turn on bass drum steps 1 and 9 and snare steps 5 and 13. Click Play to hear it, then Stop.

2. Make a second pattern. Click Duplicate to copy your beat. Add a few closed hi-hat hits to the copy so you can hear the difference.

3. Loop both patterns. Keep your first pattern in Song Order, then drag the second one after it. Click Song, then Play. The two patterns will play in order and repeat.

MIDI inputs

Connect a controller, then choose a MIDI port or listen to all inputs.

The transport light flashes green for recognized MIDI and amber for messages with no action assigned.

Pad mapping

Drum pads

MiniLab pads 1–8 play tracks 1–8 using notes 36–43 (C1–G1). Keys on other channels play the selected instrument. Choose a drum sound on any track to play it as percussion.

Tap a pad below to hear it, or connect your controller. Click REC on a drum track to arm all drum tracks, then press Play. Arm one instrument track to record the keys.

MIDI activity and velocity

MIDI activity

Play a key or tap a hardware pad to see the raw Note on velocity (1–127). Try a soft hit and a hard hit. The on-screen pad preview uses a fixed velocity and is excluded from this monitor.
